---
title: "Install"
---

nota2md needs Python 3.10 or newer.

```bash
pip install nota2md          # the HTML path, the reconstruction and the release readers
pip install "nota2md[ocr]"   # also document2md, for the image and PDF OCR paths
```

## What it depends on

| Package | What it is for |
|---|---|
| [`dofjson`](https://legistlan.github.io/dofjson/) | every request to SIDOF and to the DOF's website; the `notas-archivo` release and its titles stream |
| [`scjn`](https://legistlan.github.io/scjn/) | the `scjn-leyes` release: the readers the SCJN path calls, and the outline markers it strips |
| `beautifulsoup4` | converting a note's DOF HTML to Markdown |
| `requests` | the one direct request the DOF's website gets |
| `platformdirs` | picking the per-user cache directory |

`nota2md` requires `scjn>=0.5.1` and `dofjson>=0.5.0`, both from PyPI; nothing
in either imports back from it. The OCR paths need
[`document2md`](https://legistlan.github.io/document2md/) and its `mineru`
server, which are heavy, so they are an optional extra imported lazily: the HTML
path works without them.

## The cache directories

Three packages, three caches, none shared: clearing one must not clear another.

| What | Where | Override |
|---|---|---|
| what nota2md itself derives: the one snapshot `legal_provisions` extracted, the DOF notes it built | `nota2md.cache.CACHE_DIR` (`~/.cache/nota2md` on Linux, `~/Library/Caches/nota2md` on macOS) | `$NOTA2MD_CACHE_DIR` |
| the four SCJN releases | `scjn.cache.CACHE_DIR` (`~/.cache/scjn`) | `$SCJN_CACHE_DIR` |
| the `notas-archivo` release | `dofjson.titulos.CACHE_DIR` (`~/.cache/dofjson`) | reassign `dofjson.titulos.CACHE_DIR` |

The SCJN readers are disk-first: a `codNota` whose law is not on disk raises
`scjn.release.AssetNotCached` inside `scjn`, and `legal_provisions` falls back
to the DOF for it, with a warning, rather than downloading. Put the law there
first with `nota2md download federal-laws` (see [Command line](cli.qmd)).

## GitHub rate limit

Resolving a release's parts asks the GitHub API once, where an unauthenticated
address gets 60 requests an hour. When `GH_TOKEN` (or `GITHUB_TOKEN`) is set,
that request carries it as a bearer token; without one nothing changes. The
asset downloads themselves are outside that quota.

## Development install

```bash
pip install -e ".[test]"
pytest tests --ignore=tests/test_leyes_44.py
```

The ignored file reconstructs 42 federal laws from their DOF decrees, fetched
for real; CI runs it in its own `network` job. Four tests of `test_builder.py`
patch `document2md.converter.*` and skip themselves when the `ocr` extra is not
installed (`pip install -e ".[test,ocr]"` runs them; `document2md` has no
`onnxruntime` wheel for macOS x86_64).
